WITH year_total_s AS (
    SELECT c_customer_id customer_id,
           c_first_name customer_first_name,
           c_last_name customer_last_name,
           c_preferred_cust_flag customer_preferred_cust_flag,
           c_birth_country customer_birth_country,
           c_login customer_login,
           c_email_address customer_email_address,
           d_year dyear,
           SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) year_total
    FROM customer
    JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 1998 OR d_year = 1999
    GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year
),
year_total_w AS (
    SELECT c_customer_id customer_id,
           c_first_name customer_first_name,
           c_last_name customer_last_name,
           c_preferred_cust_flag customer_preferred_cust_flag,
           c_birth_country customer_birth_country,
           c_login customer_login,
           c_email_address customer_email_address,
           d_year dyear,
           SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) year_total
    FROM customer
    JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 1998 OR d_year = 1999
    GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year
),
combined AS (
    SELECT t1.customer_id,
           t1.customer_first_name,
           t1.customer_last_name,
           t1.customer_email_address,
           t2.year_total AS s_year_total,
           t3.year_total AS w_year_total
    FROM year_total_s t1
    JOIN year_total_w t2 ON t1.customer_id = t2.customer_id AND t1.dyear = 1998 AND t2.dyear = 1999
    JOIN year_total_w t3 ON t1.customer_id = t3.customer_id AND t1.dyear = 1998 AND t3.dyear = 1999
    WHERE t1.year_total > 0 AND t2.year_total > 0 AND t3.year_total > 0
)
SELECT customer_id,
       customer_first_name,
       customer_last_name,
       customer_email_address
FROM combined
WHERE (w_year_total / s_year_total) > (s_year_total / w_year_total)
ORDER BY customer_id, customer_first_name, customer_last_name, customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
